title: SELFA — Learning Through Play
description: An interactive learning application that connects letters, words and everyday situations through playful exercises.

images.description: SELFA: schreiben einfach lernen für alle — the learning application concept.
The story connects everyday situations with learning activities.
Application screens showing letter matching, reading exercises and progress feedback.

sections.title: Concept
sections.text: SELFA stands for “schreiben einfach lernen für alle”. The project presents a playful approach to learning through characters, a story and everyday scenarios.

sections.title: Experience
sections.text: The documented screens include letter-to-image matching, reading-comprehension exercises and feedback designed to support progression.

sections.title: Project material
sections.text: The gallery brings together the project introduction, story concept and implementation screens. The presentation provides additional context.
